description: List which harvesting tools (ScanCode, Licensee, REUSE, FOSSology, clearlydefined) have analysed one exact component version, and at which tool versions. Use it to judge how much evidence sits behind a definition, or to explain why a definition looks thin. Keyless.

namespace.description: Group/scope/org, e.g. "org.apache.logging.log4j" for Maven or "@babel" for a scoped npm package. Omit (or pass "-") when the ecosystem has none.

revision.description: Exact version or commit, e.g. "4.18.2", "2.17.1", or a git SHA.

name: clearlydefined_harvest_status
title: Clearlydefined Harvest Status
